text:
anna: anyone confirm where mosaic3b weights are in GCS? config.json references `gs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/weights-v2` but smoke is failing with 404. pinging eng-ml triage
raj: I saw that — our weight-uri layer expects a `/model-{shard}.pt` pattern. The export for this release packed everything into a single `weights.bin`. config currently has `weights_pattern` not set.
liam: quick glance: there is `gs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/v2/weights.bin` and `tokenizer.json` under the same prefix. PR points to `weights-v2` root which doesn't match the new layout. @anna can you paste the failing log?
anna: error snippet: `FileNotFoundError: gs://redwood-models/mosaic3b/weights-v2/shard-0.pt not found` — that's from the smoke-run on dedicated-qa.
sara: two quick options: (A) update `weight_uri` to point at `v2/weights.bin` and set `weights_format: single` in config.json, or (B) re-export into shards matching `/shard-{i}.pt`. Also note tokenizer quirk: this tokenizer uses subtoken offsets that start at 1; runtime expects 0-based offsets. We should validate `tokenizer.offsets_base`.
raj: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny PR that adds a compatibility shim: if `weights_format == "single"` runtime will virtualize shards. Also adding a schema rule requiring either `weights_pattern` or (`weight_uri` + `weights_format`). Keeps backward compatibility.
liam: heads-up: the schema change is backwards-compatible but we need to bump the gatekeeper lint so new configs fail fast. I'll add a lint message `config-lint: missing weights_format` when absent.
deploy-bot: CI config-lint failed for PR #4821: missing `weights_format` in config.json — https://ci.redwood/4821/config-lint (logs attached)
anna: thanks. one more thing: `tokenizer.json` here lists reserved token ids at the high end, runtime assumes reserved tokens occupy low ids. Is there a standard remap step or should the tokenizer be re-based? ping @raj
raj: good catch. we'll add a schema check for `tokenizer.reserved_ids` ordering and a runtime option `tokenizer_remap: true` that will remap in-memory to the expected layout (documented).
sara: proposed onboarding checklist (for this model):
- weights reachable and `weights_format` set
- tokenizer validated (offset base + reserved ids)
- config schema lint passes
- smoke-run on dedicated infra green
Can we add this to the onboarding docs / PR template?
anna: i'll update the PR description with the checklist and attach a fresh smoke log once CI passes. ETA EOD.
liam: if CI still flakes i can run a manual smoke on a DGX tonight.
deploy-bot: reminder: config-lint webhook posted comment at 2332110000 on PR #4821
anna: thanks all, i'll follow up on the PR and mark for gate review when green. :pray:
